title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani gets emotional when her baby moves in her womb, as Anbu makes anklet and bangle sounds. Vennila threatens Vigneshwaran's wife when her son tries to visit Rajasekar's home.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
episodeTitle: Vetri Is Stunned by Abinaya's Move
description: Sandhya asks Vetri to prepare the final budget quotation for the contract to prove his skills. Vetri is shocked to receive a court notice from Abinaya seeking a divorce from him.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Manjamalai blesses Azhagar with garlands while under divine influence. Santhanam blocks the path as Azhagar carries the sacred pot and villagers carry Mulai Paari for the ritual.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: After spotting Shruthi at Malar's home, Thangaraj clashes with Karthi and takes her back home. Later, Ragavan lashes out at Shruthi as she apologises and pleads for forgiveness.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: After Sakthivel reveals Saravanan's secret marriage, Pandian warns him that he will die if he marries Anjali. Just as Saravanan is about to tie the Thali, Pandian stops him.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Feeling ignored by the family, Chandayatha breaks into tears before Cheran. Pallavan's curiosity takes a funny twist when Chandayatha reveals spices and flour in her suitcase.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Muthu, Meena Share a Joyful Moment
description: Muthu and Meena enjoy village life and share a happy moment. Elsewhere, Devika urges Manoj to take Kanaga on a couple's trip, but he asks her for money to purchase land.

title: Chinna Marumagal
episodeTitle: A Poisonous Twist at the Eye Camp
description: Tamizhselvi volunteers to help doctors at Sethupathi's eye care camp. Eshwari secretly swaps the eye drops with poisonous ones, and unaware patients receive them from the doctors.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Lakshmi questions Kandhasamy for blaming Indhira for the QR scam and causing her distress. Concerned by Indhira's distress, Kandhasamy kindly prepares and serves dosa for her.
